messages:
nina: Heads-up: onboarding reports show lots of 429s from the 'batch-embed' Node sample. Users hit quotas on first run.

sam: Are samples doing Promise.all?

nina: Yeah, 40 concurrent calls. No client-side throttling.

ishaan: We should add a small RateLimiter in SDK + a paced paginator helper.

rate-bot: Example header seen: `HTTP/1.1 429
retry-after: 4`

sam: Node SDK currently uses exp backoff but ignores Retry-After. Need parity with Python.

ishaan: Proposal: SDK exposes RateLimiter({rps, concurrency, honorRetryAfter: true, jitter}) and a util pacedIterator(pageIter, intervalMs).

nina: UX: detect demo keys and default to conservative limits (2 rps, concurrency 1) and print a console warning.

sam: Tests: fake 429s, assert wait >= retry-after, ensure jitter applied.

ishaan: Telemetry: emit `sdk.local_throttle` event when limiter delays a request (opt-out).

nina: I'll update sample and docs snippets. I'll also open a ticket.

rate-bot: Created RDW-6001: "SDK: add client-side RateLimiter + Retry-After handling" assigned to @sam.

sam: I'll take it.
